Rotaract District 3131 is a dynamic and impactful non-profit organization dedicated to creating positive change in the world, working in close collaboration with Rotary International District 3131 (RID 3131). Functioning directly under the guidance of Rotary International, Rotaract District 3131 empowers young leaders to make a significant difference in their communities and beyond.

Formation and Scope : Rotaract District 3131 was established at the start of Rotary International Year 2008-09, following the bifurcation of RID 3130. It encompasses the Raigad and Pune revenue districts of Maharashtra, India. Membership and Reach it is comprised of over 100 Rotaract clubs.It has a vibrant network of 2300+ Rotaractors.Rotaractors are individuals aged 18 and above, fostering a diverse and inclusive community of young leaders.

Rotaractors belong to an age group of above 18 years (no age limit) and primarily work in the standing committees of Professional Development, Club Service, International Services, Community Service, Foundation, and Finance Services. Presently, there are 80+ Rotaract clubs functioning cooperatively in RID 3131.

Digital Classrooms for Rural Education: Over 100 schools equipped with e-learning facilities, bridging gaps in access to quality education.

Initiatives such as “Satyam Vikasah Chronicles” and the 365-Day Rotaract Content Drive are strengthening district communication and identity.

Signature youth-driven events like Rota Trek 2.0, Drishti – Building Image, Building Youth, and Rotary–Rotaract Meets are uniting members through purpose and passion.

The Rotary Foundation (TRF) Drive: Joint Rotary–Rotaract efforts have amplified awareness and contributions toward global causes, making “Service Above Self” a shared mission.

Together, Rotary and Rotaract of District 3132 embody the spirit of Integrity. Unity. Progress. — transforming vision into action and teamwork into lasting impact.

Rotaract District 3206 is a vibrant youth movement under Rotary International, representing a strong network of clubs across regions of Coimbatore and Palakkad. Built on a foundation of leadership, service, and fellowship, the district is committed to empowering young individuals to become changemakers, transforming ideas into action, and turning passion into purpose.

Our guiding motto is “Fellowship through Service,” reflecting our belief that meaningful community impact and personal growth go hand-in-hand.

OUR MISSION
To unite clubs and members within District 3206 under transparent leadership, collective service, and mutual support — delivering purposeful solutions for communities and fostering a brighter future for all.

OUR VISION
To cultivate a lively, welcoming, and inclusive district that uplifts communities through committed service, empowers youth leadership, and builds long-lasting positive change through solidarity and support.

WHAT WE STAND FOR
* Building a collaborative and supportive network of clubs and Rotaractors, from campus-based to community-based clubs.
* Promoting youth engagement, leadership development, and social responsibility through service initiatives, community projects, and fellowship events. 
* Encouraging transparency, trust, and unity across the district as we grow together in purpose and impact.
* Fostering a spirit of innovation, compassion and collective action — where each Rotaractor can contribute meaningfully to society while also growing as a leader.

GOALS & SCALE
Rotaract District 3206 aims to bridging both campus-based and community-based clubs to promote youth engagement, environmental awareness, social service and leadership.

With a team of dedicated leaders, Rotaract 3206 continues to plan and execute impactful initiatives — from community projects to district-wide events — offering its members opportunities for growth, service, fellowship, and lasting impact.

From the land of Enlightenment and Salvation to land of forest and minerals. From the Lord Buddha, Lord Mahavira and Bhagwan Birsha Munda this land is blessed with many legendary personalities. Being the cradle of civilization, Bihar also homes to the World’s first republic - Vaishali, World’s biggest stupa at Kesaria and country’s oldest capital - Rajgir and one of the oldest universities- Nalanda. Jharkhand being the home to India’s finest mineral reserves, state is known for its waterfalls, hills and holy places; Baidyanath Dham, Parasnath, Dewri and Rajrappa are major religious sites. 

Together, Bihar and Jharkhand forms an amalgam of unique cultural heritage full of diverse ethnic communities and traditions.
